spark_open.description: The creature is a quadrupedal, bear-bodied animal shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background. Its head, ears, and paws are those of a brown bear with dense brown fur, a lighter tan muzzle, and dark claws, while the entire neck, back, sides, and outer surfaces of the legs and tail are covered in a glossy, black, segmented exoskeleton of overlapping hard plates. A single large, glossy black, sickle-shaped horn with two small thorn-like points on its inner curve rises from a plate on the forehead and curves backward then forward over the head. The body is low and stout, standing on four thick legs, with a short, pointed, armored tail hanging down at the rear.

meta_spark.description: A large quadrupedal creature with the furry brown head, ears, muzzle and clawed paws of a bear combined with a glossy black segmented exoskeleton over the rest of the body. A long curved black horn with small spikes rises from a plate on top of the head. The back, neck, sides and upper legs are covered in overlapping hard dark plates with rows of oval openings along the flanks, and the four stout legs are sheathed in the same segmented armor down to the furry feet. The armored body tapers to a short pointed segmented projection at the rear.
